description: Five seam defect fixtures regenerated offline from s5bv5_swell.mp4 (+ s6v5_trapdoor.mp4 for the hard cut). Zero API calls. Validates tools/seam-check.py: exit codes and RATIO bands. Bands, not exact decimals, because libx264 output can drift across ffmpeg versions; measured values from 2026-08-17 (ffmpeg on darwin) recorded for reference.

cases.name: clean
cases.what: frame-exact split at 96 + concat-filter rejoin — the editing stack must be neutral

cases.name: dup
cases.what: injected duplicate frame at the seam (B re-opens on A's final frame) — the defect a one-sided PSNR gate REWARDS

cases.name: drop
cases.what: injected dropped frame at the seam (double motion step)

cases.name: hardcut
cases.what: unrelated-clip hard cut (swell first half -> trapdoor first half)

cases.name: shift12
cases.what: synthetic pure 12px horizontal translation at the seam (geometric jump; 12px at 1080w = 3px at the 270px proxy)
